name: Context Trainer
description: Choose your starts, learn each run once, and train with a clear next step.

run-minutes.name: Minutes per run (unless 5 passes)
run-minutes.description: Keep the same target and StartPos until this much active play or 5 consecutive target passes. Starts change only between attempts. Passing the target never restarts play; later runs are recorded too. Applies after the first pass; Next run can switch earlier.

break-reminder-minutes.name: Break reminder interval
break-reminder-minutes.description: A notification after this many active minutes, at the end of an attempt. Never pauses the game. No reminders during the first pass. Set 0 to disable; the plan's Break reminders option must be on.

recent-attempts.name: Recent attempts
recent-attempts.description: A full sample of this many attempts is needed to mark a context repeatable.

required-successes.name: Required successes
required-successes.description: Successes needed within the recent sample. Capped at Recent attempts. These are adjustable training heuristics.

block-attempts.name: Attempts per block
block-attempts.description: Used only by Tools > Session manual blocks. Automatic training has no attempt limit.

cps-budget.name: CPS block limit
cps-budget.description: Used only by manual blocks for runs tagged CPS. Does not interrupt automatic training.

success-notification.name: Notify when a window is passed
